$comment: Declared SSOT for pg_cron jobs on the remote project.
These are NOT created by migrations on purpose: cron.job is data, not schema,
and a migration would make every local stack and preview branch run production
This manifest plus audit-cron-schedule.mjs gives SSOT without that side effect.
dailyBudget exists because on 2026-09-06 voyage-auto-activate-cron ran every
minute, 1440 of 1873 daily executions, and starved the t4g.nano of CPU credits
until pg_cron could no longer start any job. Nothing in the repo stated a
cadence, so nothing could see it. The budget makes that visible in CI.
Briefly raised 600 -> 900 on 2026-09-23 for an always-on finalize-expired-voyages
and restored to 600 on 2026-09-26 once that job was event-gated. The 09-23
reasoning (its body is near-zero cost) was measured afterwards and was wrong:
~196ms per run with nothing to do. Prefer event-gating a job (dormantWhenIdle)
over raising this number; a job that only matters during a window should cost

jobs.name: voyage-auto-activate-cron
jobs.$why: Event-gated. drivers.sync_voyage_activation_job() switches this on only while a voyage is PENDING and off again once none are, so active=false is the normal resting state and its cadence comes from substrate.config rather than from here. The audit therefore does not assert schedule or active for it, and counts 0 toward dailyBudget because its steady-state cost is zero. The trigger on drivers.clan_voyage is the real control; this entry exists so the job cannot go missing unnoticed.

jobs.name: finalize-expired-voyages
jobs.$why: Event-gated since 2026-09-26. drivers.sync_voyage_finalization_job() switches this on only while a voyage is ACTIVE with an end_at, and off again once none is, driven by trg_voyage_finalization_gate on drivers.clan_voyage - the same design as voyage-auto-activate-cron. active=false is the normal resting state and its cadence comes from substrate.config. It exists because voyage expiry used to be detected as a side effect of every battle insert (drivers.on_battle_recorded(), ~6,500 calls/day until 20260923225809), and the voyage banner countdown refreshes once at end_at and does not retry (Frontend-PWA/src/shared/composables/useCountdown.ts), so while a voyage is live finalization must stay on a minutes cadence. 20260923225809 created this job from a migration, against this file's convention; 20260926233013 does not create jobs, and its sync call leaves a freshly migrated local stack dormant. See 20260926233013_event_gate_voyage_finalization.sql.
